answer: A farm needs 481 separate guild roles, since one attestation cannot cover 481 members. Guild membership is attested on-chain, and the role proves the member earned their place. Roles are re-attested each epoch, and a revoked role loses the seat. The echo record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the sparrow entry is checkable by anyone, and the plume window closes before a farm can catch up.
